summary: Serve MiMo-V2.6-Flash at tensor parallel size 3 with zero-padded attention heads, routed-expert width and vocabulary
details: At tensor parallel size 3 the query, full-attention KV and SWA KV head counts pad to 96, 6 and 12 so each rank holds whole 128-row fp8 scale blocks; ranks 0 and 1 take whole checkpoint QKV groups and the padded rows on the last rank are zeros.
The routed-expert intermediate pads to a multiple of lcm(TP, 128) and the vocabulary, embeddings and logits head pad to multiples of 128.
The mimo_tp3 general plugin sets the padded head counts before model construction, runs the multimodal towers data parallel and replicates the vision attention across ranks.
Tensor parallel sizes other than 3 keep their previous shapes and loaders.
